verdict.rationale: Crash-resumable crawling is a fair question for a browser-automation and data-extraction platform, but the evidence pack does not document crawl checkpointing or resuming after a crash. The `pauseWhen` feature is an intentional human-in-the-loop pause that continues once the user replies. That is an adjacent control, not checkpoint-based crash recovery, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can resume a crashed deep crawl from a saved checkpoint instead of restarting from scratch
